context.transcript:
Now turning to local news, the annual Art Walk Festival will be held this Saturday.
The festival offers residents the chance to discover local art galleries and to talk with gallery owners and artists.
The walk starts at the Clareton City Hall where you'll receive a map showing all the participating galleries.
And this year, for the first time, food from local restaurants will be available at each gallery.
Information about parking for the event can be found on the city's website.
context.transcript_translation:
现在转向本地新闻，年度艺术漫步节将于本周六举行。
这个节日让居民有机会发现当地的艺术画廊，并与画廊主和艺术家交谈。
漫步从 Clareton 市政厅开始，您在那里会收到一张显示所有参与画廊的地图。
今年，首次，本地餐厅的食物将在每个画廊提供。
有关活动停车的信息可以在市网站上找到。
